Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €32.20 per unit for a volume of 19890 pcs per year. Our Lieferzeit is 54 days, and the contract term is 12 months. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. All deliveries and services are strictly subject to our standard procedure and standard conditions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your position.

Our data shows a different picture on some points:
Our bottom-up cost model puts the full cost of this part at EUR 24.31 per unit (cost:340010).
Your rolling scorecard shows on-time delivery of 79.5% (sc:70410@2026Q3).
Our demand forecast for this part has risen 10.1% (fc:340010@2026-09).

Please find our proposal below.

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We acknowledge your increased volume of 23,400 units and the 36-month contract term, which allows us to revise our price to €31.70. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Theoretical cost models do not reflect the specialized nature of our production and our current high capacity utilization. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown. We note your delivery data and maintain our focus on supply chain stability. Our Lieferzeit is 56 days. Our proposal covers a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months, Lieferzeit 56 days, and a price of €31.70 per unit. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed the historical order data you cited; while accurate, past prices do not govern our current calculations. Furthermore, our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

We are prepared to adjust our offer to a price of €31.50 per unit. This proposal incorporates your requested volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months, and a Lieferzeit 56 days.

This is our letztes Angebot. Please decide. This offer stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
